# Fedlex treaty test fixtures (real, Swiss publication of multilateral treaties)

Unmodified Akoma Ntoso files of the Classified Compilation (SR chapter 0, international treaties), downloaded on
2026-10-14 from `https://www.fedlex.admin.ch/filestore/fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/...` (the Fedlex website's public
mapping of the linked-data file store) with the ULIS research User-Agent. Each file is stored gzip-compressed
(`*.xml.gz`) next to the fetcher's metadata (`*.xml.meta.json`: URL, status, retrieval time), in the cache layout
used by `PoliteHttp`. Checked for strings that look like secrets before committing: none.

| Path (under `cache/www.fedlex.admin.ch/filestore/fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/`) | Content |
|---|---|
| `1974/2151_2151_2151/20220201/{de,fr,it}` | European Convention on Human Rights (SR 0.101), consolidation of 2022-02-01 |
| `1974/2151_2151_2151/20220916/{de,fr,it}` | The same, consolidation of 2022-09-16 |
| `1987/1807_1807_1807/20200629/{de,fr,it}` | Protocol No 6 (SR 0.101.06); the Italian file has the scope table as an annex component |
| `1963/772_769_797/20220316/{de,fr,it}` | Statute of the Council of Europe (SR 0.192.030) |
| `2003/160/20150623/{de,fr,it}` | Charter of the United Nations (SR 0.120) |

Official enactments are not protected by copyright (Art. 5 Copyright Act, SR 231.1); reuse is subject to Art. 49
para. 1 Publications Ordinance (SR 170.512.1).

Dies ist keine amtliche Veröffentlichung. Massgebend ist allein die Veröffentlichung durch die Bundeskanzlei.
